_comment: Files still over the 500-line limit (docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md), enforced by
tools/policy/file_size.py. This list is only allowed to shrink: the gate fails
on an oversized file that is not listed AND on a listed file that is no longer
oversized, so an entry cannot outlive the work it covers.
It is empty, which is the finished state: every file in the repo is within the
limit. Adding an entry needs a reason naming why the file is not decomposed in
the same change. 'Out of scope' is not a reason.
